context_requirements: MAO-A or MAO-B expression in the cell line
adrenergic or serotonergic neuronal phenotype for canonical MAO inhibitor transcriptional effects
falsifiers: reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
induction of MAOA or MAOB target genes or monoamine-related transcriptional programs
shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines at 10 micromolar

evidence.supports: MAO inhibitor M-30 has neuroprotective and APP-lowering effects in neuroblastoma cells, not broad transcriptional responses in non-neuronal lines
propargyl MAO inhibitor TV3326 suppresses apoptosis in dopaminergic SH-SY5Y cells
MAO-B inhibitor isatin affects survival of dopaminergic neuroblastoma cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner
ladostigil, a cholinesterase-MAO inhibitor, upregulates antioxidant enzyme mRNAs in neuroblastoma cells
chronic phenelzine increases hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenocortical activity in mice, a systemic neuroendocrine effect
